name: n8n-hubspot-gdpr-ccpa-consent-preference-sync
description: Compliance sync for n8n and Node.js: ingests signed consent-banner preference updates (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Osano, or custom), maps granular cookie categories to HubSpot compliance properties, and applies GDPR / CCPA rules for marketing unsubscribes, global unsubscribe, do-not-sell, and processing restriction. DRY_RUN and SANDBOX_MODE are on by default.

scripts.verify: npm run check:workflow && npm run validate:workflow && npm test
